headline: Green Wednesday: cannabis discounts squeeze retailers
pages: While food, travel and wine cost more this Thanksgiving, cannabis is getting cheaper. The days before the holiday, known as Green Week or Green Wednesday, now rival 4/20 as the busiest sales time for dispensaries, with long lines and steep discounts. Cannabis is a $30 billion US industry with legal markets in 24 states and the District of Columbia, according to Whitney Economics. In recent years, deep discounts have kept customers coming back but squeezed retailers and contributed to a revenue decline in the legal market. At The Forest, a dispensary in Baltimore, shoppers stocked up on items such as gummies to bring to Friendsgiving in place of alcohol, and sparkling THC drinks. Source: NPR.
